packageRules.description: test-apply.yaml holds cloud credentials, so its actions are pinned to full SHAs. Renovate rewrites both the SHA and the trailing '# vX.Y.Z' comment, which is the only thing that keeps a pin from silently going stale.

customManagers.description: tofu_version pinned on opentofu/setup-opentofu. Without this the version is frozen forever and nobody notices; with it, an OpenTofu release arrives as a reviewable PR instead of breaking the nightly on a day nobody touched the code.
